body: Along the eastern side of the Galle Fort is the Old Dutch Hospital, one of the oldest buildings within the fort. It tended to the medical needs of Dutch East India Company employees and Dutch sailors. The veranda has stood the test of time. Its history under British rule included as military barracks and the town hall. The 50cm/20" walls kept out the heat and humidity. Today it has been resurrected with an array of shops, cafes and restaurants. While not a big shopper, the transition in use has given the building a new raison d'etre. It is one of the most impressive structures in the fort.
title: FROM PATIENTS TO PATRONS

body: Early on, the Dutch established well-constructed hospital buildings in coastal settlements such as Colombo, Galle, and Trincomalee. As settlements grew into cities, the hospital buildings occupied prime locations. In Galle, the Dutch built their hospital near the harbor on the site of the old Portuguese mint. The building was used as an administration building under the British and eventually it became the town hall. Recently, in 2014, it was rescued from disrepair and restored to become a "shopping precinct." It is one of the oldest buildings in the fort area, and its beautiful colonial style architecture was preserved, providing a charming building for boutiques and restaurants with inviting courtyards and views on the second floor of waves breaking over rocks. There is also a wide area for parking. On a gray and overcast day in May, as we explored the second floor, we often had to pause and look out over the ocean before hurrying on to discover the next shop. We must admit, at the end of the day, we didn't buy much because the prices seemed high.
title: What a pleasure to shop here

body: The original construction date of this building is unknown, but the first reference to it as a hospital was by Johann Saar, a German mercenary in the service of the Dutch East India Company. In 1647 he wrote "On the left side as one approaches (Galle harbor) is seen the hospital where formerly the Portuguese had their mint." The Dutch colonists replaced the Portuguese in 1640 and since the Dutch fort was built between 1649 and 1663, the hospital predated the fort, but was enclosed within its walls. When the British took over from the Dutch in 1796, the 2-storey building was still being used as a hospital and the adjacent street was named Hospital Street, as it is today. In the mid 19th century, the hospital building was extended by the British and converted to a military barracks. The building subsequently went through several more transformations, firstly to government administration offices and then, after Independence, it became the Galle Town Hall from 1948 to 2003. In 2006 the International Council on Monuments and Sites with funding from American Express and World Monuments Fund commenced conservation work on the old building under the purview of the Urban Development Authority and some construction work by the Sri Lankan army. The restoration work concentrating on the main structure of roof, walls, windows and other architectural details and the sewage system was completed in March 2011 and on 20 September 2013 it was officially opened to the public as the Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct by President Mahinda Rajapaksa. But what a fine job they made of it. Today the 2-storey building in a pleasing mix of Dutch and British styles, and painted brilliant white, the colour of choice for government renovated buildings in Sri Lanka, has a paved colonnade on both sides shielding some very smart shops and restaurants. Several antique bicycles within the colonnade complete the picture. The upper storey overlooks the sea at the rear. Within this historic building now are many smart restaurants, cafes, bars, boutique, gem and souvenir shops and an exclusive watch store. On our previous visits we have spent several hours browsing these shops, but this time we were just looking for dinner and, spoilt for choice, spent a long time trying to decide which restaurant to visit. In the end we chose well, but they all seem to provide good meals.[Background details from Wikipedia & Sri Lankan Airlines]
title: Historic Building Given New Lease of Life

body: We were 4 nights in Galle over new year and loved this place becauseSugar is a burger place that was really rather good when everywhere else was fully booked. crab and tuna is a high end classy Japanese restaurant. The tea and craft shops were lovely for browsing and gifts. Tap house is a lively pub and at a minute by tuk tuk you can sit with the most superb sea view whilst eating the best prawn curry you’ll ever have. The shared toilets BTW are important - not too many public toilets in Galle this clean and high end. And NYE come down here - a very tricky evening when travelling historically for us to get to deliver its promise, but we had the best time jumping around to the beats and dodging the crazy fireworks - brilliant!
title: We loved it...again and again

body: Well… I was probably misleaded by the word “shopping precinct” – but I was quite disappointed when I got there. Of course, the building of the former Dutch hospital is looking nice and it’s a good example for the colonial architecture in the fort area. But I expected more. There are few shops and some restaurants but nothing that you would let a shopping addict’s heart beat faster.
title: A bit disappointing

body: Very beautiful building, especially at night. Sitting outside and grabbing a beer while the salty sea breeze cools you down is perfect. Also, the local Casanova will try to chat up your girlfriend when you're off to take pictures. XDLearnt my lesson though, never leave your spouse alone ; )
title: Nice area to spend an evening

body: A couple of nice restaurants in this precinct, cool shops and a good clean toilet - also has a great view of the bay
title: Nice spot for a visit while at Galle Fort

body: Not a lot happening in this centre when we were there. The building itself was the best part of the visit
title: Very quiet

body: Lovely building which has been converted into a range of bars, restaurants and shops but retained the original features and charm. You can also eat and drink outside in the courtyard
title: Well worth a visit

body: Its worth a visit as it offers a good architecture. It was part of the historic Galle Fort, now it hosts shops and expensive restaurants.
title: Part of Galle Fort history

body: There is a historical value to this complex. This was one of the hospitals made by Dutch with in the Galle fort. Recently this was turned into a modern shopping complex. There are coffee shops, jewelery shops and pubs in this complex which specially targets the high end customers and tourists. According to someone's taste the place can be good or too expensive.
title: Good enough for a hang out

body: Beautiful old fort building. Shops a little sparse but a good compact Batefoot and Odel. Lots of good restAurants and bars to chose from. Well worth a visit
title: Worth a visit for the architecture

body: upmarket shopping in this and nearby precinct - has good books ,art work nearby and the post office is nearby for postage stamps and post cards
title: quality shopping

body: So it may be slightly more expensive in the fort , but it’s hassle free . Having shopped over the cheaper local side , and having a few people take you to a special spice market etc . This is chilled and better quality , albeit more expensive . Depends what you want . It is no where near as much hassle as some of the other countries I’ve been such as Egypt, Morocco, or at the worst India . You can shop at your pace , picking up souvenirs, local art work , Pursuing museums .. stopping for a beer , ice cream , coffee, lunch and dinner plenty of places to look at .
title: Hassle fee shopping

body: Great place with a lot of history, sea facing and with narrow lanes dotted with cafes and restaurants, curio shops etc. All in all a nice relaxed and fashionable ambience
title: Lovely place, very quaint

body: Lovely location with good places to eat. you can also shop for jewelry & tea. we had a wonderful lunch here.
title: Lovely location with good places to eat

body: Charming refurbished old hospital now a lovely area full of shops and restaurants. Great view from balcony but expect to pay top dollar... And do not be surprised with your bill as its all NET, so both service charges and tax comes on top...
title: Lovely but pricey!

body: Used to be a hospital built by the Dutch during the colonial times. Now its repurposed to facilitate restaurants boutique shops and jewellers. Most of the shops sell high end expensive products.
title: Shopping and restaurants

body: This place has a historic importance as it was built centuries ago when the Galle was under the rule of Dutch. This place was a Dutch hospital then and recently it was developed to a shopping complex. It is situated in the Galle Dutch Fort and here you can have high quality foods, costumes, restaurants,bars ... etc.
title: High quality food

body: Between the gift shops, tea & spice shops, spas and restaurants - you can find them all within this majestic building. And while you're in it, don't forget to walk up the steps to the next floor for a wonderful view of the waves crashing against the rocks and the sea wall.
title: Must visit

body: Good restaurants and one of the few places you can grab alcoholic beverages in the Forte. Nice spa there also.
title: Cool space for dinning & a drink overlooking Galle Harbour

body: The Dutch built the hospital 400 years ago to take advantage of the fresh sea air for their patients, the modern day restaurants that now occupy the space take good advantage of that decision. Interesting shops, good food all in one place, but beware as with most places within Galle Fort the shops are where the tourists go, not the locals!!
title: Fabulous location, fabulous shopping

body: An old hospital that has been restored and now more of a shopping center with many restaurants in it. Nice place to relax after walking through the old fort area.
title: A shopping place

body: The former hospital has been developed into shops & mainly restaurants. We sampled two there & weren't disappointed. Lovely spot to sit down for a drink or more...
title: Great relaxing zone

body: Nice for drinks or lunch and dinner in a modern restaurant but in a very historic setting. Always a breeze on the first floor
title: lots of nice restaurants

body: Not sure what this precinct is for. Essentially a series of over priced shops selling broadly the same trinkets at 3 times the price in Galle. Lots of expensive jewellery shops at prices Bond Street would find hard to justify. Clearly aimed at the affluent tourists, this is not the real Sri Lanka!Lots of average food venues, but despite being a tax free area, you will find 29% added to your bill.....and at one hotel cafe, 5 cokes and 3 ice creams came to £40!!!!So go walk around, buy nothing, go buy cheaper elsewhere.
title: Over rated

body: Loved the view!! My husband and I visited almost daily for lunch and drinks. The food was great and they always had good music playing. We even had a massage.
title: Relaxing

body: The building is wonderfully maintained. The restaurant is very good and being so close to the ocean and at one end of the colonial area of Galle, you would like to come here many times during your stay.
title: Splurge if you want on the gems, or just have a beer!

body: This is often quite busy but you can usually get a drink or a meal at one of the restaurants. Sometimes there is music in the square.
title: Plenty of cafes and restaurants

body: Beautifull preserved fort, interesting to see it all. Lovely shops, no problem to spend some money here!
title: interesting and enjoyable.

body: A smaller version to the sister in Colombo but worth a visit more food than shopping but very nice all the same.
title: Nice vibe

body: The Dutch Hospital is nice for a look and wander through the shops. It is a piece of history that should be checked out when in Galle
title: Nice for a look

body: It compares poorly to Colombo's Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct. There are just about food places here & nothing much to shop about. At least when we visited - there were hardly any people as well !
title: Just about food - not really shopping precinct !

body: They have done a lovely job on this old hospital building. There are two levels which host some nice boutiques and restaurants catering for the kind of travellers who these days Tay within the fort walls. I would no doubt eat there if staying in Galle
title: Beautifully restored building now hosting boutiques and restaurants

body: The Dutch Hospital has kept much of its character, although it is a shopping and dining place. The upper level, which still has its original board floor, is now a parade of high class shops and mid price restaurants. Even if you do not want to eat, it is worth a visit, as the rooms along this upper level, overlooking the sea, will have originally housed patients, or later part of the British Garisson.
title: Preserves the atmosphere

body: We stayed in this area for one night only and had a guided tour including this hospital precinct which was interesting to see how it had been adapted for retail outlets.
title: Interesting building

body: All you need centrally located with some really good restaurants, cool pubs, Bristos, cafes and boutique shops. However staff at washrooms can be quite rude, even to patrons of the premises. After having a good meal in one of the restaurants we went to change into beachwear in the washrooms and were shouted at by the staff saying it's not allowed which would he very weird anywhere in the world.
title: A gallery mall in a colonial building

body: You'll never believe that an old hospital building could be so innovatively styled into a shopping cum dining arcade. This is one place in Colombo I would like to be, especially on a pleasant evening. With a wide variety of restaurants to choose from, and with plenty of seating options (AC indoor setting and a more natural outdoors), with a largish number of expat crowd, plenty of music (both recorded and live) and some good brand names like Odel, Ministry of Crab (owned by celebrity cricketers of SL), etc.... you'd rather be here than anywhere else if you are dining out with colleagues and friends.Especially on a cooler/rain scattered evening, the view around you if you are seated outdoors is quite nice, and if you have a chilled beer and good food for company, well that's about all one needs after a busy workday.
title: Great place to hang around on a pleasant evening

body: Several good restaurants - would especially recommend Starbeans cafe on the 1st floor. The building overlooks a beautiful bay which leads to the open-air fish market in Galle.
title: Beautiful old Dutch Hospital now converted to restaurants and shops.

body: dutch hospital shoppin precint are the shops around the fort. were you get to buy souveniers, clothes, gems basically promoting the traditional goods of srilanka. its a very good feel. there are some good resto bars also, its half a day well spent over there
title: a traditional shopping area at galle

body: Here you can see one more Dutch hospital turned into a great place of attraction.You can shop, eat, even see movies.
title: A great place to visit for spending some quality time

body: Unless u want to head there for a meal, there is nothing much else to go there for.We went there for Ministry of Crab which was outstanding but if otherwise, there's no need to visit the area. Disapppointing
title: Just an enclave of eateries nad one or two shops

body: Nice old building but now occupied by numerous cafes restaurants all much the same and biased towards European menus. Not particularly interesting and much the same as any highs treeI suggest one of the smaller specialist places in the old fort area .
title: Just a row of restaurants

body: Great bars, some shops and oodles of history. Worth a look, if only to get out of the sun for 10 minutes
title: Great little precinct

body: The building is house to many gem stores and some of the upscale restaurants in Galle fort. The architecture is interesting. One could drop by for a quick look around the building.
title: Shopping at Galle

body: If you like gem shops and lots of other junky tourist stuff this place is perfect. Upstairs is nice for a beer and lunch with good views of the harbour. The building itself is quaint. The ladies loved the super clean and modern toilets.
title: Great spot for clean modern toilets

body: Wonderful views as well as restaurant options. Finally zeroed in on Tuk Tuk, which was a wonderful decision.
title: Great location for browsing and Eating options

body: This is one of our favorite nooks in Galle. Spent several days and nights here shopping for excellent tea selections, gifts and also dining in its good number of restaurants. A very breezy and airy version of its Colombo counterpart, this was a beautiful refurbishment of a forgotten heritage structure.
title: Great collection of shops, restaurants and bars

body: The Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct has branches of some of Sri Lanka's iconic stores all conveniently located together and whilst non have full stocks if your short on time this is a great location for a one stop shop for gifts and souvenirs. More significantly the complex is home to some great restaurants, bars and a great tea shop.
title: More eating than shopping

body: We had a little wander to have a look round. There are a variety of eating and drinking places and a few shops. Not a bad place to check out for a couple of hours.
title: Some good eating places

body: This quaint shopping precinct has restaurants, bars and little shops as well as a very clean toilet! The prices are a bit high but like all of Galle Fort, its interesting architecture is worth a visit.
title: A lovely part of Galle Fort

body: certainly one of the more upmarket commercial place to hang out in the old town of Galle with restaurants and shops.
title: elegantly restored and hippest place in town.

body: Inside Galle Fort, Old Dutch Hospital complex with very nice restaurants with reasonable pricing and good tasty food.
title: Nice Place to visit

body: The precinct is a collection of bars, restaurants and shops located in a beautifully restored colonial hospital, originally built during the Dutch occupation of Galle! A cool place to take a break for a refreshing drink and snack!
title: Beautiful Colonnaded Building!

body: The hospital now has many cute (up-market) shops and restaurants - especially nice are the ones upstairs which offer a view of the bay
title: Well-restored with nice views

body: The restaurants and jewellers which have remained open since the opening of the Dutch Hospital are a real cut above the Colombo Hospital precinct. Good parking and excellent views are an added bonus. Orchid House has moved and si stilll worth a visit
title: More buzz, better restaurants than Colombo equivalent

body: This is a lovely restoration of the hospital which is now an upmarket shopping precinct. Mostly restaurants, including the excellent The Tuna and The Crab and jewellery stores.
title: Nicely restored

body: great options for food and shopping, drinksCeylon Tea and Souvenir shopsSea food - affordable but high end restaurantsnear to Galle Fort area
title: Great food and shopping options around

body: They made a big song and dqance about this place but it is nothing special. A lot of restaurants trying too hard to be trendy... only a few of them work. Amazing building and I am surprised it is not full of people.
title: Not up to hype

body: Nice old buildings now turned into a bit upscale shoppingplace. Nice bar and restaurants for a chillout while in the vicinity.
title: Shopping shopping and a drink

body: We went into one of the curio shops here and left very smartly. The prices were four times what we paid at Laksala the day before. We didn't bother staying any longer.
title: Beautifully restored but shops are a rip off.

body: A must for a drink or lunch overlooking Galle bay on the first floor. Boutique shops are quite expensive.
title: Beautifully restored colonial gem, stylish bars with a view over the bay

body: The old hospital is beautifully restored. Good selection of shops and restaurants and great clean toilets. Great view from the upstairs restaurants.
title: High end but great for a treat after touring the fort

body: We visited this three times during our stay to shop and eat. It is well worth a visit. Like the Old Dutch Hospital in Colombo, it is quite up-market but the quality of the offerings is good.
title: Smart shopping, good restaurants

body: The Dutch Hospital in Galle has a lot more to offer than the one in Colombo. It has a greater choice of restaurants and shops & is adjacent to the old streets of Galle Fort which has a great selection of shops, cafes, bars and restaurants to suit all budgets.
title: Great dining options.

body: Don't come here for actual shopping. In fact, there are only just a few shops here.However, do come here for the excellent restaurants! Great food at decent prices.
title: Great restaurants

body: I love the concept repurposing a historic building. That being said, this caters to a high end tourist crowd. I don't enjoy this setting very much.
title: Pricey places to spend tourist dollars

body: Again the architecture of the town and what it must have been like in its heyday was apparent with this magnificent, huge old hospital building. You know its really good they have kept, maintained and reused these as all to often they are not used again.Glad to report this is a interesting and old part of this wonderful town.
title: Basically a lot of craft shops.

body: This is a successful example of utilising old space and giving it new life. The building is beautiful and walking its "corridors", you can actually get a feel of times past when people where sick in the tropics, far away from home. Well, that's only my imagination :) What is there for real, is a good shopping experience, lots of souvenirs and jewellery as well as good dining. I recommend the upper floor's diners as they offer a lovely sea view.
title: Hospital turned into a shopping centre

body: Tasteful re-purposing of old colonial hospital structure. Now housing upscale shops and restaurants. Only down side is that prices are mostly very high.
title: Modern use of colonial structure!

body: Good spot for some food, jewellery, cup of coffee etc. Very clean and well kept, good toilet facilities.
title: Good spot for food and shopping

body: An Old Dutch hospital turned to a place to have good dinner. Buidling/Architecture is quaint and offer scenic views for the fort and sea. Certain nights (weekends) events are held at the foyer.
title: Dinner

body: This old building has been beautifully redone and there are great restaurants to choose from, the atmosphere is very different to the rest of the Fort.
title: Great Restaurants

body: A well preserved and well maintained historical building by the sea within Galle Fort. Some interesting shops and a variety of decent restaurants. We avoided the gem shops but enjoyed shopping for clothes and knick-knacks in the other stores. Restroom facilities excellent. Good place to visit.
title: Historic Building Housing Great Shops & Restaurants

body: Beautiful old building repurposed into a restaurant and shopping area. A variety of eating places will give you some choices, a good place to watch the ocean with a beer. There are jewellery stores and craft shops but they are lost on me. Can"t speak about their worthiness.
title: Beauty building

body: The Dutch hospital precinct is more of a food haven than anything else, with over a dozen restaurants offering an international variety of food.This is a tourist place so dont be surprised if you dont see any locals around, only the ones serving you.RecommendationDo stop off and try some of the drinks, have a look around first as the prices can differ a lot.
title: Highlight of Galle Fort, Great variety of Food

body: good for shopping? i don't know, i just love this building & corridor with sunshine + sea breeze. that is quite enjoyable & relax.
title: good for shopping? i don;t know

body: The building is beautifully restored. I tried a few cafes there as I was staying close by. The food is mainly western style and not that great. Plus it is expensive for what it is. The beer was expensive too - about 3 to 4 times the normal price. Be warned, the prices there do not include tax and "service charge". Some prices are on a par with Australian cafe prices!!There are some tea shops in there which were unbelievably expensive. I saw some of the same tea in a grocery store in the 'new' town area of Galle for a fraction of the costs.This is a tourist trap. Overpriced, not that good with ordinary service.
title: Nice building - ordinary food and service

body: It's great to see efforts being undertaken to preserve heritage buildings such as the Dutch Hospital, but looking at what has become of it, I wonder what it adds to its environment. With so many expensive souvenir shops and restaurants, who gains from this? It seems to me an example of international gentrification, sucking the life and originality out of the place. Then what is being preserved? But it definitely looks great...
title: What does it add?

body: Once it was a Dutch Hospital, this beautiful colonial building is today a lovely styled shopping arcade, hosting various shops, restaurants and cafes.It is located at Hospital Street on the eastern side of Galle Fort.It shall not be missed because it is very much worth a visit.
title: A place not to miss.

body: Nice shops to look at in this area. It is a bit pricey for what I can afford but if you have some extra cash you get can some nice unique things.
title: Good shopping

body: We enjoyed mooching around the shops and then eating in the restaurant upstairs. Overlooking the ramparts of the Dutch first with fabulous sea views. Afternoon tea is served 3pm -6pm, delicious.
title: Great cafes and restaurants with shops

body: The shopping and dining here seems to be of better quality here, and naturally, prices tend to be higher too. Nice place to explore though.
title: Good for some shopping and dining

body: There is few shops for tourists and many different kind of restaurants. Clean toilets for free use as well. Not that "free wifi" needs local ID to login
title: Good variety of choices

body: Good shops and restaurants within the building. Easily accessible from ramparts or by road. Nice place to rest from the heat of the day
title: Modernised building

body: My sister, in a wheelchair, following an accident in Sigiriya, tried to get to restaurants here. The majority are wheelchair inaccessible. We beat a hasty retreat. Most disappointing
title: Wheelchair unfriendly

body: This lovely building has been thoughtfully restored and is a mixture of shops and restaurants. Just nice to walk through if you don't want to shop!
title: Beautiful Colonnade

body: Quite a bit of variety offered if you are willing to shell out a wee bit more than the usual! No complaints about the food or the service, worth the amount and the ambiance!
title: High-end, down south!

body: Beautiful historical building, beautifully restored, but no offering great dinning, good shopping and spectacular views across Galle bay.
title: Nice shopping and great restaurants

body: If you can handle the steps up to the first floor, there are several eateries, mostly with views over the harbor. There are quite a lot of shops selling jewelry and tea related products and the building has a good feel about it being quite old but recently well restored and refurbished.
title: First floor gallery is a great place to eat

body: This place is newly modified and converted to a shopping arcade while maintaining the old dutch architecture.My favorite shop is Orchid House which is full of Souvenirs , Gem and Jewelries and ornaments.
title: Dutch Hospital

body: The shops within this building beside the ocean at the edge of the Galle Fort aren't particularly impressive and are pricey. The draw for us was an evening visit for the Tap Room bar and A Minute by Tuk Tuk restaurant. The Tap Room serves the ubiquitous Lion beer but has good cocktails at Aus$6 each. Music was covers of 50s/60s/70s hits but suited the atmosphere. When we visited the place was full of backpackers having fun. Upstairs is the restaurant which overlooks the ocean, made spectacular the night we visited by a lightning storm that lasted two hours. Food and service were good. Be aware that restaurants in Galle largely cater to tourists and travellers, there is little typical Sri Lankan food.
title: Good bar and restaurants, pricey shopping

body: The history through this area is amazing and they have made fantastic use of the historical building. The shops are pricey so you're best off heading into the sidestreets
title: Great food options but pricey shopping

body: Just around the corner from the lighthouse in the old hospital building. Full of restaurants, so great choices for lunch. Well maintained historic building
title: Excellent old hospital building full of restaurants

body: The old Dutch Hospital has several bars and restaurants and is a good place to relax after visiting the Fort
title: Good for relaxing

body: This place has some really good restaurants and bars with some shops. the 1st floor has the stunning view of galle harbor and peace pagoda of rumassala. Saturdays and Sundays can be bit crowded.
title: well maintained premises with restaurants and shops

body: This place has a collection of bars and restaurants, some with a gorgeous view of the Indian Ocean . The restaurant s can be pricey but it is a decent well maintained property. There is a variety of shops but out of my price range .
title: Decent place for food and drink

body: This place has a selection of bars and restaurants where you can enjoy lunch and dinner with the fresh smell of sea air in your nostrils
title: Food

body: Galle was an interesting historic area and much better in many ways than expected. The dutch Hospital area was steeped in history and well maintained. and definitely worth spending some time.
title: Historic And Interesting

body: Not worth the visit as the shopping in the lanes of Fort is more attractive then this experience. Plus the dining does not offer any views and do not have good quality local souvenirs.
title: spent one hour in the morning with spouse

body: Very nice. Lot of shopping boutiques. great places to just walk around. close to the beach as well as galle fort....
title: Excellent place to hangout on a sunday...

body: We ate at A Minute by Tuk Tuk and had a beer at one of the bars. We'd give it a 5 if it wasnt so pricey (sorry!) It was a little annoying that pretty much everyon on the balconies smoked, so everyone around us was smoking as we were eating - this hasnt affected the score but thought we'd mention
title: Lots of restaurants and good views from the restaurants on the balcony

body: This grand old building has been tastefully and sympathetically restored and is now home to several resturants and interesting shops. The building is situated on Hospital Street just down the road from the Lighthouse. Nice shops, some rather interesting jewellery, worth having a look around, even if only to admire this gracious old building.
title: Well restored building

body: The Dutch hospital precinct is synonymous with Srilanka and present in both galle and colombo. These precinct are old hospitals which have been converted into restaurants and shopping districts. The one is Galle has a number of restaurants and is right next to the sea. A good option to roam around and have food at one of the outdoor restaurants, with a good view and sounds of the sea.
title: Transformation of old Hospital

body: The Dutch hospital has a selection of dining venues and shops, all good. It's a good use of the space and a welcome addition to the other shopping areas in Colombo. If looking for Barefoot products I would venture to the main store on Galle Road.
title: Multiple shopping and dining options

body: Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct located in Galle fort, Building has lots of places to drink and few expensive places to Shop, visited a minute by tuk tuk, good place to chill around with nice views. Shopping in other areas of Galle fort is better then Dutch hospital building. Nothing great about this place.
title: Expensive shopping and great place to eat

body: A lovely old building housing the Taproom.Great cocktail at good prices and home to Tuna and the Crab,seafood seriously good with a Japanese twist.
title: Great food great drinks.

body: The building retains its old look but is full of interesting shops and some good restaurants. Spend time there.
title: A delightfully restored building

body: A nicely renovated building with some restaurants - but plenty of those in Galle - and some expensive jewellery shops. Nice view from the ramparts but sunset is the other end of town! From the other reviews I expected the place to be buzzier and full of stalls/more shops...perhaps over time as the site becomes more popular.
title: Not sure what all the fuss is about....

body: Its just a few shops and restaurants in an area that was once a Dutch hospital. No more than that! The rampart by this part of the fort looks out eastwards.
title: Not very interesting

body: Nothing special. Expensive shops. Upstairs resturents are great. they are expensive too but you can get the best food you can think of. Only thing is if they have more shops that actually let us go enjoy the place would worth more.
title: Great place to eat

body: A nice place to relax in the evening. Same concept as Colombo Dutch hospital. Done a great job with the restoration of the old building. Good restaurants specially canon bar. Enjoyed the seafood platter, maple glazed pork chops, calamari with salad.
title: Great night ambiance

body: We ate in the Dutch Hospital Precinct every day whilst in Galle. There are a good selection of restaurants to chose from with some thing to suit,the fussiest of diners. There are amazing views of the fort walls and harbour from most tables. The meals and service were great at all the restaurants we dined at.
title: Some of the better restaurants in Galle.

body: THis building looks very sturdy and is well maintained. Several shops and cafes now occupy this space.
title: Well maintained

body: A beautifully restored old hospital which has been tastefully renovated with respect ( the Brisbane city council could learn a lot!!)I can't comment on the shopping but the food, drinks and atmosphere were fabulous!! After wandering around the streets of galle enjoying the history and stories of locals, the old Dutch hospital is a great place to sit and relax enjoying a drink and some great food. Definitely a must to top off a great day. The tap house and sugar bistro are a must.
title: A must visit for a drink and good food!!!!

body: Location is super nice but the shops are a bit repetitive. Teashops, gems and souvenirs. At least restaurant are a bit more mixed
title: Nice but...

body: This place had been opened to the public very recently and visiting this place if you are in Galle definitely will give you a nice experience. However it offers you a bit expensive shopping experience. Great location for photography if there is less crowd around.
title: Add to the must visit list in Galle!

body: The building looks smashing and is quite photogenic ! Hosts tons of restaurants - especially on the upper floors as well and some shopping joints ! Good to relax after walking around the fort area !
title: Best for the restaurants it hosts !

body: A mixture of cool bars, trendy cafes and some interesting shops. The tea/spice shop on the first floor has ferocious air conditioning why is very welcome when it is blisteringly hot. It also sells excellent tea.
title: Touristy but stylish conversion of an old hospital

body: This place has all the hi-end restaurants, coffee shops and bars. There is also sushi place. Your average bill for 2 peole would around $30-40. Good for a beer or a glass of wine.
title: Hi-end restaurants

body: Spent some time here wandering about, and dropping in to bar and restaurant for a drink.Some good shops where I managed to get rid of some money.
title: Some interesting shops and a couple of restaurants.

body: Unless you are looking to buy jewelry and you know the business really well, your going to pay too much. Everything here is really expensive and we did not see much by way of artisan-made work.
title: Mostly overpriced jewelry shops and restaurants

body: We were regular visitors here on our recent visit to Galle.Filled with shops, restaurants, bars and cafes, it's a one stop shop.Nicely renovated and a perfect spot to spend an evening in Galle.Also worth a mention is the cleanliness of the toilets, they were excellent.A place you must visit when in Galle.
title: Loved the old Dutch hospital

body: The Dutch Hospital has been nicely restored and has a good selection of local gift shops. There are a variety of restaurants and bars to choose from. Good views of the bay and close to the lighthouse.
title: Nice shops and restaurants

body: Worth a visit during your stroll through Galle. The air-conditioned shops are lovely and the restaurants are worth a try. We went upstairs for a cool drink in Tuk Tuk.
title: Opened recently and worth a stroll through the shops

body: This was a great open space to relax, grab a bite or have a drink while making walking around the fort. Late afternoon, early evening would be a pleasant time to sit outdoors, as it gets pretty hot in the day.
title: Lovely open space

body: Terrace dining overlooking the sea great selection of food ,but you have to try Sri Lankan ,curries like you dream of ,if this is not for you then there is plenty of menu's to suit everyone's taste.Prices are cheap compared to european dining and drinks are reasonable also ,for the ladies plenty to see in the lower floors
title: Galle Fort

body: Good place to rest and some of modern restaurant, clean and quiet place for tourist to relax and nice restroom.
title: Good place to rest and food

body: The Dutch Hospital has been converted to boutique shops, bars and restaurants. There is outdoor seating which has a cooling breeze.
title: Great use of an old building

body: Eat at 'A minute by Tuk Tuk' upstairs in the Dutch Hospital precinct. You get a cool breeze sitting outside and the food totally delicious. Well worth going there.
title: Interesting shops and food outlets

body: Its in the old hospital building. All the shops and restaurants and high end and pricey but its lovely to visit and get out of the heat of the day.
title: For the big spenders

body: This shopping complex is in the renovated Old Dutch Hospital. Prior to being renovated for the current use it was used as a government building.It has many nice restaurants and shops. We looked at the menu in a couple of them and they seem expensive, but so is most of the Fort area.
title: New, nice and expensive

body: This is a great place to dine when in Colombo. There are a good number of cafes and restaurants that you can visit. The eateries there are slightly on a pricey side (you pay for the ambience too) and a really nice spa that you can visit. Restaurants close around 9ish -10PM so if you're looking for a nice place to dine and chill, the Dutch Hospital location is good. Odel, a popular souvenir shop is located there too !
title: Vibrant nightlife

body: Historic location with multiple places to grab a drink or seafood. Plenty of seating outside to breath the sea air and take in the historic feel of the place. I was in Galle Fort for a week, and visited this place almost every day.
title: Bars and food next to the old fort wall and ocean

body: Worth a trip to stop by and look at the shops and eat lunch with a nice sea breeze and view. Also have lovely, clean public toilets (for Dutch Shopping Precinct Shoppers only.....) on the 1st floor behind One Minute Tuk Tuk
title: Good food outlets with nice views and nice handicraft and tea shops

body: It is nice to see what can be done when they turn their attention to sensitive restoration. There are many bars and restaurants offering items for a wide range of prices. Some lovely boutique shops on the upper floor and a good place to sit and people watch.
title: A nicely restored and repurposed building, with restaurants, bars and shops.

body: Feel chilled and relaxed in the middle of the busy Colombo Fort. Nice cafes and restaurants. Not low budget but it's worth trying if you want to take a break from street food
title: nice place to chill out in the middle of Fort

body: This is a nice area for souvenir shopping and having a drink or meal. There are a variety of shops and types of meals.
title: Good Shopping and places to eat

body: When all the day trippers have gone it's a great place to wander around the upmarket shops, bars and restaurants in this fully restored historic building.On the evening I visited there was a band playing live music in the "court yard" making for a great relaxing and enjoyable atmosphere
title: Charming Night Time Venue

body: This is used as drop off point by many tuk tuks and taxis also next to the lighthouse, beautiful buildings housing shops and restaurants, walk along the wall at the back and see great views out to sea.
title: Lovely Buildings

body: Nice place with great options to shop and eat... beautiful trees and fort with colonial Dutch style buildings, if you are a history lover or an architecture, or shopping lover a place you can visit in Galle.
title: Great place to visit ...

body: We had brunch at a restaurant upstairs at Starbeans Ocean Restaurant & Cafe. Excellent coffee and a good English Breakfast. Fantastic views. Helpful staff.
title: A lovely collection of shops and eateries

body: It is a very popular place for tourist and locals. There are very restaurant, coffee shops, shop. There is also outdoor seating, which customers are able to admire the beautiful ocean.
title: Dinner

body: Beautiful building with excellent sea view from the first floor. A tat expensive but very nice restaurants with more on the menu than your avarage rice and curry.
title: Lovely diners

body: We walked through In the early evening, people were sitting out having a drink and various shops and eateries were still open and the area had a 'new' feeling to it. We only looked downstairs but it looked as if there were more shops upstairs. Public toilets appeared to be at the far end. Seeing people sitting out made the whole area look very tempting and attractive.
title: Attracitive

body: There is a Dutch Hospital site in Columbia tastefully converted into bars and restaurants. This is similar and done well.
title: Much like Columbo

body: They have converted this old hospital very well. There are 2 eateries and all the other establishments on the ground floor sell fashion items or gemstones.
title: Very nice building, expensive shops

body: Nice to wander around and stop for a drink or bite to eat. Good view of the bay from upstairs. I found myself coming back each time I visited Galle as the best toilets are there on the ground floor.
title: Good Clean Loos !

body: Definitely take a stroll through this shopping area if you are already visiting the fort but it is nothing special in terms of goods or prices. It does focus a bit more on 'high end' items such as jewels, watches, paintings, etc.
title: Nice if you are already in the fort but nothing special

body: Food of all types from burgers to sit-down meals can be found here, and the ambiance is interesting. Whatever your budget, you should be able to find something.
title: Filled with nice restaurants

body: The building is historically beautiful and significant and now houses at least three better quality restaurants and a few shops.
title: More A Series Of restaurants Than Shops

body: This beautiful building from the Dutch periodwas turned into a shopping place with overpriced shops. a real tourist trap. Walk around and enjoy the beauty but shop in other places.yona s.
title: A beautiful tourist trap

body: Arcade of differing shops, lots of jewellery stores and also souvenir shops. Choice of bars and cafes upstairs
title: Plenty of jewellery shops and also food outlets on top floor

body: This isn't a big mall. It's a small square that has shops and restaurants. The restaurants seemed good. Many options to choose from. Any tourist would like to shop here as its different from a mall or a normal shop.
title: Decent place for shopping and dining

body: This whole building is amazing! From the high end designer shops on the ground floor, to the touristy jewellers and wierd souvenier shops upstairs, plus the fantastic cafes all over the place, makes this a MUST SEE in Galle!
title: Beautiful

body: One of the best restaurant arcades in Galle Fort which has so many choices of food to select from..many good restaurants inside with variety of food...
title: Many choices to dine
Place is filled with people
body: Quite popular not only among Sri Lankans but also among foreigners as well. Foods and beverages are quite expensive but 5 star service is provided among restaurants over here.

title: some great places to eat
body: A must when in Galle. Great architecture . An unique concept to convert an old hospital building into some famous sea food restaurants. Similar idea even in Colombo.

title: A good, but small, centre
body: This has been done really well with various eating and drinking places. There are also the usual gem shops if you are in that mood. Worth a visit if in Galle Fort.

title: Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct in Galle Fort
body: The Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct in Galle Fort was opened on the 20th September 2014. There are shops to browse and restaurants to eat/drink in with views over Galle Harbour, worth a visit.
